objective: Record the public prerequisites, absences, human dependencies, custody boundary, and exact unblock conditions for Steps 15 through 17 without executing them or accessing reserved or private material.

authority.role: controlling public Gate B readiness audit
controlling public Steps 11 through 14 non-execution report

public_content_safety.permitted_content: Aggregate status, public hashes, public prerequisite categories, role definitions, and unblock conditions only.

public_absence_checks.basis: The controlling Steps 11 through 14 audit states that readiness is incomplete and no official Gate B run occurred.
No public Step 14 final report, development result namespace, release manifest, or Gate B release artifact was present.
No public appointment or confirmation record establishes a custodian for reserved selection, custody, release, and authoritative seal retention.
No public opaque commitment suitable for a frozen Step 15 release was present.
No current executable protocol binds reviewed policies, independently checked benchmark judgments, validation rules, budgets, denominators, and the corrected identity and extraction interfaces.
No public Step 15 report, result namespace, primary-output seal, or permitted-change inventory was present.
No public Step 16 report, immutable triage namespace, independent human responses, adjudication, denominators, or cost record was present.
No public approval record establishes a finite exploratory scope, budget, private-boundary confirmation, or disclosure-review authority.
Step 15 has no immutable primary output and Step 16 has no independent human triage or adjudication.

step_15.requirement: An official Gate B PASS under criteria approved before the Step 14 run.
step_15.unblock_evidence: A versioned Step 14 report and authoritative seal recording Gate B PASS.

step_15.requirement: A reconstructible frozen release manifest covering code, baselines, tools, protocol, policies, configuration, seeds, scoring, and stop rules.
step_15.unblock_evidence: A hash-bound release manifest plus independently verified authoritative seal.

step_15.requirement: A current executable reserved protocol with fixed eligibility, sampling, factual setup, policies, validation, budgets, retries, and outcome definitions.
step_15.unblock_evidence: A pre-outcome frozen protocol approved under the research contract.

step_15.requirement: A named or confirmed custodian holding an opaque reserved commitment and authoritative copy outside developer access.
step_15.unblock_evidence: A user-approved custody record and commitment verification procedure that reveals no reserved identity publicly.

step_15.requirement: Human-authored or explicitly adopted policy bytes with primary provenance and a different human reviewer before outputs.
step_15.unblock_evidence: Hash-bound author/adopter and distinct-review attestations retained by the evaluation process.

step_15.requirement: Working current-interface causal validation and exact rules for evidence grades, admitted state, attacker capability, and repaired-target contrast.
step_15.unblock_evidence: A completed Step 13 driver and sealed development controls tied to the corrected identity and extraction interfaces.

step_15.requirement: A fresh evaluator and an actual isolated release procedure separating reserved material from development agents.
step_15.unblock_evidence: Custodian release record, commitment match, evaluator isolation attestation, and opening check.

step_15.requirement: Predeclared per-case continuation, failure preservation, immutable primary-output, and permitted-write procedures.
step_15.unblock_evidence: Frozen run instructions and change-inventory schema included in the release.

step_15.requirement: Step 8 through Step 10 integrity controls remain reproducible.
step_15.unblock_evidence: Already verified public seals; these do not substitute for any missing Step 14 or custody prerequisite.

step_16.requirement: Immutable Step 14 release evidence and immutable Step 15 primary outputs.
step_16.unblock_evidence: Verified Step 14 and Step 15 seals with zero mismatches.

step_16.requirement: A frozen inclusion rule, randomized tool-masking procedure, equal context policy, and preserved randomization record.
step_16.unblock_evidence: A preregistered packet generator and custodian-held decoding map.

step_16.requirement: Independent human triagers using frozen response forms without prefilled judgments.
step_16.unblock_evidence: Human assignment record and sealed initial responses created only after Step 15 packet freeze.

step_16.requirement: A distinct human adjudicator and a documented adjudication procedure preserving initial responses.
step_16.unblock_evidence: Adjudicator assignment and append-only adjudication record.

step_16.requirement: Frozen definitions and denominators for correctness, policy relevance, exploitability, causal attribution, duplicates, unresolved units, precision bounds, and resolution coverage.
step_16.unblock_evidence: Step 12 protocol and Step 14 release manifest binding the exact forms and formulas.

step_16.requirement: Prospective human, AI, computational, runtime, memory, timeout, and wall-clock records.
step_16.unblock_evidence: Sealed prospective logs; missing measurements must remain explicitly missing.

step_16.requirement: Validation evidence remains separate from primary outputs and preserves E3 versus E4.
step_16.unblock_evidence: Sealed Step 15 validation records and unchanged primary-output hashes.

step_16.requirement: Advisor or research-lead review of all three Gate C dimensions after reproducible scoring and adjudication.
step_16.unblock_evidence: Reproducible applicability, comparative-utility, and confirmed-impact records followed by documented human decision.

step_17.requirement: Step 15 primary outputs are sealed before exploration begins.
A separate explicit approval for exploration that does not alter the reserved evaluation.
step_17.unblock_evidence: User-approved exploratory charter recorded after Step 15 sealing.

step_17.requirement: A finite candidate set with exposure history and exact revisions fixed before analysis.
step_17.unblock_evidence: Researcher-approved private manifest retained outside public and synchronized roots.

step_17.requirement: A finite human, machine, run, and wall-clock budget with stop rules.
step_17.unblock_evidence: Approved budget and stop record fixed before the first exploratory run.

step_17.requirement: A researcher-confirmed private destination outside public and automatically synchronized repositories.
step_17.unblock_evidence: Private-boundary attestation retained without publishing the destination.

step_17.requirement: The exact frozen release and local-only investigation procedure are available.
step_17.unblock_evidence: Gate B release manifest and verified local execution instructions.

step_17.requirement: External disclosure remains a separate human decision under the applicable process.
step_17.unblock_evidence: Researcher review of any private draft and separate authorization before contact or publication.

human_and_custodian_roles.required_action: Approve Gate B criteria before Step 14 and decide the three Gate C dimensions only after Step 16 evidence.
Hold reserved identities, sources, judgments, policy materials, pseudonym map, commitments, releases, and authoritative seals outside developer access.
Author project-specific policy and permitted semantic annotations from primary sources before reserved outcomes.
Review the exact policy bytes, assumptions, permissions, obligations, and transformations before outputs.
Verify commitments and execute the frozen release in an actually isolated environment without changing analysis or policy.
Provide initial judgments under the same rubric for every method after randomized packet freeze.
Resolve disagreements only after initial judgments are sealed and preserve every original response.
Approve Step 17 scope and budget, verify private findings, and separately decide whether any external contact is authorized.

non_substitution_rules: A prompt authorization marker is not an access-control mechanism or custodian release.
An AI agent cannot substitute for a human policy author, reviewer, triager, adjudicator, advisor, or disclosure decision-maker.
A public hash or local seal is not custody, isolation, authorship, policy review, or an authoritative off-workspace copy.
Development, synthetic, historical, or exploratory evidence is not fresh reserved evidence.
A draft protocol or runnable script is not a Gate B PASS or frozen release.
Unfilled response forms or agent-generated judgments are not independent human responses.
Step 15 completion is provisional and cannot substitute for Step 16 triage, adjudication, costs, or final Gate C decisions.
A warning, accepted proof, or new bug alone does not establish E4, broad accuracy, or comparative utility.
UNKNOWN, unsupported, timeout, crash, missing output, or no warning is not safety evidence.
Step 17 findings cannot be relabeled as untouched held-out or Step 15 reserved results.
Ignoring a location in version control is not a privacy boundary.
This readiness audit does not authorize reserved access or any Step 15 through Step 17 execution.
private_boundary_safeguards: Do not place candidate identities, judgment values, source contents, policy contents, pseudonym maps, release bundles, or evaluator outputs in public or synchronized roots.
Do not inspect, reconstruct, enumerate, or infer reserved membership during readiness work.
The custodian releases only the minimum frozen material to the fresh evaluator after Gate B PASS and commitment verification.
Step 16 packets are randomized and tool-masked while preserving substantive information; the decoding map stays under custody.
Step 17 evidence and disclosure drafts remain in a researcher-confirmed private destination; public reporting is aggregate or explicitly approved and redacted.
No maintainer contact, public issue, third-party pull request, transaction, or live-system test occurs without separate explicit authorization.
Public readiness records contain only aggregate state, public hashes, role requirements, and unblock conditions.

step_15: Complete and seal Steps 11 through 13 under new explicit authorization.
Run Step 14 under criteria approved beforehand and obtain an official Gate B PASS.
Freeze and independently verify the complete release manifest and executable reserved protocol.
Have the user name or confirm a custodian who retains the opaque commitment and authoritative copy outside developer access.
Freeze human-authored or adopted and distinctly reviewed policies and permitted annotations before outcomes.
Have the custodian verify and release the committed material to a fresh isolated evaluator with a recorded opening check.
Issue explicit Step 15 access authorization only after every preceding condition is recorded.
step_16: Seal all Step 15 primary outputs and permitted-change inventory without analyzer or policy changes.
Freeze randomized tool-masked packets, inclusion rules, forms, formulas, denominators, and the custodian-held decoding map.
Assign independent human triagers and a distinct adjudicator before responses.
Seal initial responses before adjudication and retain unresolved judgments visibly.
Reproduce scores, costs, precision bounds, resolution coverage, and evidence grades from retained records.
Obtain documented human decisions for applicability, comparative utility, and confirmed impact; only then is Gate C reached.
step_17: Obtain a separate user-approved exploratory charter, finite private candidate manifest, exact revisions, budget, and stop rules.
Have a researcher confirm a private destination outside public and synchronized roots without publishing it.
Use only the frozen release and local execution, preserving exposure history and uncertainty.
Keep all exploratory evidence separate from Step 15 and stop at the approved budget.
Require separate researcher review and authorization for any external disclosure.
